scripts.test:report: powershell -NoProfile -Command "npx playwright test; $r = Get-Content './reports/results.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $s = $r.stats; $d = [math]::Round($s.duration / 1000, 2); $date = ([datetime]$s.startTime).ToLocalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'); $summary = '# Playwright Test Summary' + [Environment]::NewLine + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Test date: ' + $date + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Passed: ' + $s.expected + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Failed: ' + $s.unexpected + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Skipped: ' + $s.skipped + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Flaky: ' + $s.flaky + [Environment]::NewLine + '- Duration: ' + $d + ' seconds' + [Environment]::NewLine + [Environment]::NewLine + '## Errors' + [Environment]::NewLine; if ($s.unexpected -eq 0) { $summary += 'No failed tests reported in this test run.' } else { $summary += 'Check playwright-report/index.html and reports/results.json for failure details.' }; Set-Content './reports/test-summary.md' $summary -Encoding utf8; Write-Host 'Updated reports/test-summary.md'"
